verdict.en: Nothing current needs it, so sell it for a fat 2,000 coins each.
verdict.zh: 没有现行用途，直接卖，一个值 2000 钱币。

obtain.en: Spawns in Mechanical areas. A July guide points to the car-filled highway near Checkpoint on The Blue Gate, the Robotic Sandbox on Stella Montis and the Power Generation Complex on Dam Battlegrounds. The Stench of Corruption also pays one.
obtain.zh: 出现在机械类区域。有攻略提到蓝门检查点附近堵满车的高速路、星辰山的机器人沙盒和大坝战场的发电厂综合体；完成“腐败的恶臭”也送 1 个。

tips.en: It is also an ingredient for the Flame Spray, crafted in-round with a Fireball Burner. Only worth it if you actually want that gadget.
tips.zh: 也是“火焰喷涂”的材料，局内配合火球燃烧炉合成；除非你真想要这个道具，否则不必留。

verdict.en: Pure sell item at 1,000 coins, or keep one as Raider Den decoration.
verdict.zh: 纯卖钱的物品，一只 1000；想装饰奇袭者巢穴可留一只。

obtain.en: Only inside rooftop chimneys on Buried City while the Bird City condition is active. Nests seem limited to Italian-style buildings, so check those roofs.
obtain.zh: 只在“鸟城”条件生效时的掩埋废城屋顶烟囱里出现，似乎只有意式建筑才有鸟巢，优先搜这些屋顶。

tips.en: Throwing it makes a squeak that works as a cheap distraction, but you would be tossing 1,000 coins away.
tips.zh: 扔出去会发出吱吱声，可当廉价的声东击西，但等于扔掉 1000 钱币。

verdict.en: A 7,000-coin chimney duck: always take it, always sell it.
verdict.zh: 7000 钱币的烟囱鸭，捡到必带，回去就卖。

obtain.en: Scavenge rooftop chimneys on Buried City while Bird City is active. It is a rare roll, so do not plan a run around it; just check every chimney you pass.
obtain.zh: 在“鸟城”条件下搜掩埋废城屋顶烟囱。掉率不高，别专门为它开局，路过的烟囱顺手搜即可。

tips.en: Ducks stack 15 and weigh little, so they cost almost no backpack space.
tips.zh: 鸭子可堆叠 15 个且很轻，几乎不占背包。

verdict.en: Sell it: 5,000 coins and no project, quest or recycle use.
verdict.zh: 直接卖：值 5000，没有任何任务、项目或回收用途。

obtain.en: Added in 2.0. Scavenged from Commercial, Residential and Old World buildings; the wiki names no specific containers yet.
obtain.zh: 2.0 新增，可在商业、居住和旧世界建筑里搜到，社区还没整理出具体容器。

tips.en: It cannot be recycled and stacks only 1, so sell it on the way out rather than carrying several.
tips.zh: 不可回收且不能堆叠，别囤着，出局就卖。

verdict.en: Barely worth the slot: 1,000 coins, or eat it for 25 stamina in a pinch.
verdict.zh: 勉强值得占位：卖 1000，紧急时吃掉回 25 体力。

obtain.en: Common Residential and Commercial loot. For volume, sweep Old Town on Pendola Pass (77 container spots in an ordinary round) or the Commissary Supermarket next door (36); you will pick cans up without trying.
obtain.zh: 常见的住宅和商业类物资。想多拿就扫彭多拉山口的老城区（普通对局约77个容器点）或旁边的军需超市（约36个），不用刻意找也会捡到。

verdict.en: Nothing current needs it; sell it for 7,000 coins, or keep one as decoration.
verdict.zh: 目前没有项目需要它，直接卖 7000 钱币，或留一个当摆设。

obtain.en: Epic and low spawn rate, in Residential, Old World and Commercial buildings. Buried City is the usual farm (Grandioso Apartments, Plaza Rosa, Town Hall, Santa Maria Houses, Library). Red secure lockers have the best odds. Exploring Pendola Pass also pays one.
obtain.zh: 史诗品质，掉率低，出现在居住、旧世界和商业建筑。常见刷点是掩埋废城（奢华公寓、玫瑰广场、市政厅、圣玛丽亚住宅、图书馆），红色保险柜机会最高。“探索彭多拉山口”也送 1 个。

tips.en: A Security Breach perk helps, since many of the best containers are locked.
tips.zh: 带上“破门”类天赋更好，不少高价值容器是上锁的。

tips.en: Exploring Pendola Pass pays one for free, so finish that quest before you farm.
tips.zh: “探索彭多拉山口”会白送 1 个，刷之前先把任务做了。

verdict.en: Quest item for A Path Not Yours; it has no sell value, so just hand it in.
verdict.zh: “非你之路”的任务物品，不能换钱，交了就行。

obtain.en: Follow the Nomad trail from under the Highway Collapse to the hideout, then dig up Bilguun's gift from the buried cache beneath it. Deliver it to the Nomadic Envoy.
obtain.zh: 从高速公路崩塌区下方沿游牧人的路标走到藏身处，在下方的埋藏箱里挖出比尔贡的礼物，再交给游牧使团。

verdict.en: A legendary 10,000-coin payout; sell it, or spend it on Nomadic Envoy trades.
verdict.zh: 传奇级 10000 的补偿物品：可以卖，也可以拿去游牧使团换货。

obtain.en: You do not find it in raids. It was mailed to your account as compensation for resources put into an earlier project.
obtain.zh: 局内找不到，是对此前项目所投入资源的补偿，直接发到账号。

tips.en: It stacks to 25 but weighs 6 each, so a full stack is heavy. Use it from the stash, do not carry it into a raid.
tips.zh: 可堆叠 25 个，但每个重 6，满叠很重，在储备箱里用，别带进局。

tips.en: Players report Envoys accept it toward any item category in trades. The number you get depends on how much you invested.
tips.zh: 据玩家反馈，使团交易中它可抵任意品类；拿到的数量取决于你投入了多少。

verdict.en: Sell it for 1,000; nothing else wants it.
verdict.zh: 卖掉，一个 1000，别处用不上。

obtain.en: New in 2.0, found in Commercial, Residential and Old World buildings.
obtain.zh: 2.0 新增，出现在商业、居住和旧世界建筑。

verdict.en: Low-value filler at 640 coins; sell it and do not make room for it.
verdict.zh: 价值低的杂物，只值 640，卖了就行，别特意腾位置。

obtain.en: Common loot in Residential and Old World buildings.
obtain.zh: 居住和旧世界建筑里的常见战利品。

verdict.en: Keep one for Scrappy level 4, then sell the rest for 1,000.
verdict.zh: 留 1 个给废品仔 4 级升级，多的卖 1000。

obtain.en: Most guides say Buried City: the plastic containers on the Red Tower's outer ledge are the most reliable, and its red lockers also work. On Dam, try Ruby Residence and Pale Apartments; on The Blue Gate, the Village shelves.
obtain.zh: 多数攻略推荐掩埋废城：红塔外沿的白色塑料箱最稳，塔内红色柜也行。大坝战场去红宝石宅邸和苍白公寓，蓝门去村庄的货架。

tips.en: Put it in your Safe Pocket the moment you find it, since it looks like a sell item and is easy to lose.
tips.zh: 捡到立刻放进安全口袋，它看着像卖钱货，死一次就没了。

tips.en: The upgrade also takes 6 Prickly Pear and 6 Olives.
tips.zh: 升级同时还要 6 个仙人掌果和 6 个橄榄。

verdict.en: Quest item for Celeste's Journals; worthless otherwise, so deliver it.
verdict.zh: “塞莱斯特的日记”的任务物品，别无他用，交了就好。

obtain.en: Both are on Dam Battlegrounds, in one round: the South Swamp Outpost and the northern outpost overlooking the Red Lakes. Deliver both to Celeste.
obtain.zh: 两本都在大坝战场，需在同一局拿齐：南部沼泽哨站和俯瞰红湖的北部哨站，然后交给塞莱斯特。

verdict.en: Sell it for 1,000 coins; nothing current needs it.
verdict.zh: 卖掉，1000 钱币；目前没有需求。

obtain.en: Residential kitchens and apartments: Pale Apartments and Ruby Residence on Dam, Plaza Rosa E Apartment and Grandioso Apartments in Buried City. The Espresso quest also rewards one.
obtain.zh: 居住区的厨房和公寓：大坝战场的苍白公寓和红宝石宅邸，掩埋废城的玫瑰广场东公寓和奢华公寓。完成“浓缩咖啡”任务也送 1 个。

tips.en: It cannot be recycled, so selling is the only way to cash it in.
tips.zh: 它不能回收，只能卖掉换钱。

verdict.en: Sell it. 2,000 coins, but it weighs 1 and has no use.
verdict.zh: 直接卖。能值 2000，但重 1 又没用。

obtain.en: Residential and Commercial loot with no fixed spot. The densest areas of those types are Old Town on Pendola Pass, Hotel Panorama Azzurro on Riven Tides and the Village on The Blue Gate.
obtain.zh: 住宅和商业类物资，没有固定点。这两类最密集的区域是彭多拉山口的老城区、裂潮镇的蔚蓝全景酒店和蓝门的村庄。

verdict.en: Sell it for 2,000; no quest, project or recycle use.
verdict.zh: 卖掉，2000 一个，没有任务、项目或回收用途。

obtain.en: New in 2.0 and listed under Commercial and Residential loot; a search a week after launch found no guide naming a spot. Commercial-heavy areas such as Research & Administration on Dam Battlegrounds or the Arrival Building on The Spaceport are reasonable places to look.
obtain.zh: 2.0新增，归在商业和住宅类物资；上线一周后搜索仍没有攻略点名位置。可以去商业类集中的区域找，比如大坝战场的研究与行政区或太空港的到达楼。

verdict.en: Quest item for Outstanding Balance; hand it to Tian Wen and forget it.
verdict.zh: “未结债务”的任务物品，交给天玟即可。

obtain.en: Search Dodger's stash in the underground Traffic Tunnel, then his deal spot by the Pilgrim's Peak antenna, all in one round.
obtain.zh: 同一局内先搜通行隧道（地下）里道奇的藏匿点，再去朝圣峰天线旁的交易点。

verdict.en: A 3,000-coin chimney duck; take it, sell it.
verdict.zh: 3000 钱币的烟囱鸭，捡了就卖。

obtain.en: Only in Buried City rooftop chimneys during Bird City. Rare, so it is a bonus rather than a farming goal.
obtain.zh: 只在“鸟城”条件下的掩埋废城屋顶烟囱里出现，掉率偏低，属于顺手收获。

verdict.en: Quest item for A Dead End; deliver it to Shani.
verdict.zh: “死路一条”的任务物品，交给萨尼即可。

obtain.en: The quest sits on The Blue Gate. Power the locked door in MANTIKOR's underground with batteries, play the recording, then search beside the monitors.
obtain.zh: 任务在蓝门：用电池给 地下设施的锁门供电，播放录音，再在监视器旁搜索。

verdict.en: Nothing current needs it; sell it for 10,000 coins.
verdict.zh: 目前没有需求，直接卖 10000 钱币。

obtain.en: Legendary and random, from Residential and Commercial containers. One guide's testing found the most trinkets in Santa Maria Houses and Abandoned Highway Camp on Buried City; Grandioso Apartments, Ruby Residence, Pale Apartments and the Village on The Blue Gate are also listed. Expect many raids.
obtain.zh: 传奇级、随机出现，来自住宅和商业类容器。有攻略实测掩埋废城的圣玛丽亚住宅区和废弃的高速公路营地饰品掉得最多；奢华公寓、红宝石宅邸、苍白公寓和蓝门的村庄也在推荐之列。做好跑很多局的准备。

tips.en: Stack of 1 and weight 0.5: it takes a slot but little weight, so sell it right after the raid.
tips.zh: 堆叠 1、重 0.5，只占一格几乎不占重量，局后尽快卖掉。

verdict.en: Sell it for 1,000 coins each; nothing current needs it.
verdict.zh: 每个卖 1000 钱币，目前没有需求。

obtain.en: Search Residential and Commercial containers; rows of metal lockers are a good bet. It is also an ingredient for Agave Juice with an Agave.
obtain.zh: 搜居住和商业区域的容器，成排的金属柜不错。它还能与龙舌兰叶一起合成龙舌兰汁。

verdict.en: Keep 1 if you still need Clean Hands; sell the rest for 3,000 each.
verdict.zh: 若还没做“清理指针”留 1 个，其余每个卖 3000。

obtain.en: Rare, in Residential and Commercial containers, often on shelves and in drawers. Guides suggest Grandioso Apartments, Santa Maria Houses and the plazas in Buried City, plus chimneys during Bird City. Clean Hands is on Pendola Pass.
obtain.zh: 稀有，出现在居住和商业区域的货架与抽屉。攻略推荐掩埋废城的奢华公寓、圣玛丽亚住宅和各广场，以及“鸟城”期间的烟囱。“清理指针”任务在彭多拉山口。

verdict.en: Quest item for Espresso; take one back to Apollo.
verdict.zh: “浓缩咖啡”的任务物品，带 1 个回去给阿波罗。

obtain.en: Salvage an espresso machine in one round. Dam: top-floor kitchens in Ruby Residence and Pale Apartments, or the Research and Administration cafeteria. Buried City: the Il Maiale Dorato trattoria south of the highway.
obtain.zh: 同一局内拆一台咖啡机。大坝战场：红宝石宅邸和苍白公寓顶层厨房，或研究与行政楼的自助餐厅；掩埋废城：高速路南侧的 脚手架餐馆（招牌为金猪）。

verdict.en: Quest-only: grab one for A Reveal in Ruins, and don't expect to sell it.
verdict.zh: 纯任务物品：只为“废墟中的揭示”拿一个。

obtain.en: It sits in Buried City pharmacies. The wiki suggests the one in Piazza Arbusto, east of the Town Hall, and says to check behind the counters, where boxes are often hidden. Finish the quest in one raid.
obtain.zh: 在掩埋废城的药店里找。可以去市政厅东边的阿布斯托广场药店，柜台后面常藏着箱子。需在同一局内完成。

tips.en: Put it in a Safe Pocket so a death doesn't cost you the trip.
tips.zh: 放进安全口袋，死亡也不会丢。

verdict.en: A one-off quest item for The Root of the Matter; there is nothing else to do with it.
verdict.zh: “源头之种”的一次性任务物品，没有别的用途。

obtain.en: It is in the seed vault of the Research Building in Buried City, the room with the great view over the park on the north side. Hand it to Celeste in the same raid.
obtain.zh: 在掩埋废城研究楼的种子库里，即北侧朝向公园、视野很好的那个房间。需在同一局内交给塞莱斯特。

tips.en: The quest pays a Succulent backpack charm and 1,000 coins, so it is worth one dedicated run.
tips.zh: 任务奖励多肉背包挂饰和1000钱币，值得专门跑一趟。

verdict.en: Sell it: 1,000 coins for a 0.1 weight slot beats the tiny heal.
verdict.zh: 卖掉：0.1重量就值1000钱币，比那点治疗划算。

use.en: It heals 15 and, per one guide, makes no noise, so it works as an emergency stealth heal. A real healing item is still better for the slot.
use.zh: 能回15点生命，据一份攻略所说使用时没有声音，可当应急的静音治疗。但占格子不如正经的治疗物品。

obtain.en: Common in Residential and Commercial areas, mostly kitchens, trash cans and cases. The Commissary Supermarket on Pendola Pass is the biggest Commercial area on any map (36 container spots in an ordinary round).
obtain.zh: 住宅和商业区常见，多在厨房、垃圾桶和箱子里。彭多拉山口的军需超市是所有地图里最大的商业类区域（普通对局约36个容器点）。

verdict.en: Plain filler at 640 coins; sell it when you have space, skip it when you don't.
verdict.zh: 640钱币的普通杂物，有空位就卖，没空位就别捡。

obtain.en: Residential loot only. Old Town on Pendola Pass has by far the most Residential container spots (77 in an ordinary round), followed by Hotel Panorama Azzurro (40) and Researcher Lodgings (37).
obtain.zh: 只出在住宅类物资里。彭多拉山口的老城区住宅容器点最多（普通对局约77个），其次是蔚蓝全景酒店（约40个）和研究员住所区（约37个）。

verdict.en: The best duck: 7,000 coins per slot, but only if Bird City is running on Buried City.
verdict.zh: 最值钱的鸭子，一格7000钱币，但要赶上掩埋废城的鸟城事件。

obtain.en: Search rooftop chimneys on Buried City while the Bird City condition is active. Chimneys are tiled-roof residential buildings, with Old Town and West Village recommended, and they spawn randomly, so there is no fixed farm spot.
obtain.zh: 在鸟城事件期间搜索掩埋废城屋顶的烟囱。烟囱多在瓦屋顶的住宅楼上，推荐老城区和西村，每局随机刷新，没有固定刷点。

tips.en: Stacks of 15 mean a full stack is a big payday, but a thrown duck also makes a decent noise distraction.
tips.zh: 一组能叠15个，整组很值钱；也可以扔出去制造噪音分散注意。

tips.en: Ducks can sit on your Raider Den shelves, but selling one removes its display.
tips.zh: 鸭子可摆在奇袭者巢穴的架子上，但卖掉后展示也会消失。

verdict.en: Sell it for 2,000 coins each; nothing current needs it.
verdict.zh: 每个卖 2000 钱币，目前没有需求。

obtain.en: Residential drawers and cabinets. The wiki names Pale Apartments and Ruby Residence on Dam Battlegrounds, Plaza Rosa and Grandioso Apartments in Buried City, and the Village on The Blue Gate.
obtain.zh: 住宅区的抽屉和柜子里。维基列出大坝战场的苍白公寓、红宝石宅邸，掩埋废城的玫瑰广场、奢华公寓，以及蓝门的村庄。

tips.en: It can't be recycled, so selling is the only way to cash it in.
tips.zh: 无法回收，只能卖掉换钱。

verdict.en: Sell it for 3,000 coins each; nothing current needs it.
verdict.zh: 每个卖 3000 钱币，目前没有需求。

obtain.en: Random Residential and Commercial loot. Guides agree southern Buried City is the best bet: Santa Maria Houses, Plaza Rosa and Grandioso Apartments. Ruby Residence and Pale Apartments on Dam Battlegrounds and the Village on The Blue Gate are the alternatives.
obtain.zh: 住宅和商业类随机物资。攻略一致认为掩埋废城南部最好：圣玛丽亚住宅区、玫瑰广场和奢华公寓。备选是大坝战场的红宝石宅邸、苍白公寓和蓝门的村庄。

tips.en: At 0.2 weight and 3,000 coins it is a better slot than most trinkets, so pick it up.
tips.zh: 重0.2却值3000钱币，比大多数饰品划算，见到就拿。

verdict.en: Broken Monument quest item; deliver it to Tian Wen.
verdict.zh: “破败的纪念”任务物品，交给天玟。

obtain.en: Dam Battlegrounds, around the broken-down vehicles near the Scrap Yard's hallowed grounds. Collect it together with the tape and rations in one raid.
obtain.zh: 大坝战场，废料场圣地附近的报废车辆旁。需与录像带和口粮在同一局内集齐。

verdict.en: Broken Monument quest item with no other use.
verdict.zh: “破败的纪念”任务物品，别无他用。

obtain.en: Dam Battlegrounds, in the Raider camp by the Scrap Yard. Tian Wen asks you not to break the items, and there may be junk lying around, so look for what stands out.
obtain.zh: 大坝战场，废料场旁的奇袭者营地里。天玟叮嘱别弄坏物品，周围可能有杂物，找显眼的那个。

verdict.en: Third Broken Monument pickup; the quest rewards an Arpeggio I.
verdict.zh: “破败的纪念”的第三件物品，任务奖励一把三连奏 I。

obtain.en: Dam Battlegrounds, near the cylindrical containers in the Scrap Yard area. The tape is labeled THE LAST BARON.
obtain.zh: 大坝战场废料场一带，圆柱形容器附近。磁带标签上写着最后的男爵。

verdict.en: A 3,000-coin Bird City duck; sell it or shelve it in your den.
verdict.zh: 鸟城事件的3000钱币鸭子，卖掉或摆在巢穴里。

obtain.en: Open rooftop chimneys on Buried City while Bird City is active. Spawns are random, so keep moving between chimneys.
obtain.zh: 鸟城事件期间在掩埋废城打开屋顶烟囱。刷新随机，多换几个烟囱找。

verdict.en: A quest key for the Spaceport tunnels; use it and forget it.
verdict.zh: 太空港地下通道的任务钥匙，用完就丢。

obtain.en: The wiki puts it in the staff locker room in the southwest of the Departure Building, near the parking lot. Then use it on any Flushing Terminal in the tunnels below the Spaceport, in the same raid.
obtain.zh: 维基说在候机楼西南角靠近停车场的员工更衣室。随后在同一局内于太空港地下通道的任意冲洗终端上使用。

tips.en: It belongs to The Stench of Corruption, a Shani quest.
tips.zh: 它属于萨尼的任务“腐败的恶臭”。

verdict.en: Colorful Shoes (Red): nothing current needs them; sell for 3,000 each.
verdict.zh: 彩纹鞋子（红）：目前没有需求，每双卖 3000。

obtain.en: Furnished Residential and Commercial buildings. AltChar names Grandioso Apartments, Space Travel and Santa Maria Houses in Buried City, the Village on Blue Gate, Ruby Residence and Pale Apartments on Dam, plus the Spaceport Arrival and Departure buildings and the Hotel Complex in Riven Tides.
obtain.zh: 有家具的住宅和商业建筑。攻略列出掩埋废城的奢华公寓、航天大楼、圣玛利亚住宅，蓝门的村庄，大坝的红宝石宅邸、苍白公寓，太空港的到达楼和候机楼，以及裂潮镇的酒店综合体。

tips.en: Stacks to 3 at 0.5 weight each, so sell them in batches.
tips.zh: 一格可叠 3 双，每双重 0.5，攒几双一起卖。

verdict.en: Colorful Shoes (Green): nothing current needs them; sell for 7,000 each.
verdict.zh: 彩纹鞋子（绿）：目前没有需求，每双卖 7000。

obtain.en: Same loot zones as the other pairs: shelves and cupboards in Residential and Commercial buildings. Buried City is rated the best overall trinket area, with chimneys during Bird City also recommended.
obtain.zh: 与其他颜色相同：住宅和商业建筑的架子、柜子。掩埋废城被评为饰品最佳区域，鸟城期间的烟囱也值得翻。

tips.en: Stack size is 1, so each pair takes a slot; sell right after the raid.
tips.zh: 堆叠上限为 1，每双占一格，局后尽快卖掉。

verdict.en: Colorful Shoes (Silver): the scarcest pair, and nothing current needs it; sell for 10,000.
verdict.zh: 彩纹鞋子（银）：最稀有的一双，目前没有需求，卖 10000。

obtain.en: Furnished Residential and Commercial buildings. The wiki lists no specific spots, so lean on the Buried City apartment and plaza areas that guides recommend for trinkets.
obtain.zh: 有家具的住宅和商业建筑。维基没有具体地点，可去攻略推荐的掩埋废城公寓和广场一带。

tips.en: Legendary and stack 1: put it in a Safe Pocket once you find one, then sell it after the raid.
tips.zh: 传说级且不可叠加，找到后放进安全口袋，局后再卖。

verdict.en: A rare duck worth 3,000 coins; sell it unless you want the display.
verdict.zh: 3000钱币的稀有鸭子，不要展示就卖。

obtain.en: Chimneys on Buried City rooftops during Bird City. It was added in patch 1.45.0.
obtain.zh: 鸟城事件期间掩埋废城屋顶的烟囱。该物品在1.45.0版本加入。

verdict.en: A 1,000-coin duck: fine as a throwable distraction, not worth a farming trip.
verdict.zh: 1000钱币的鸭子，可当投掷干扰物，不值得专门去刷。

obtain.en: Bird City chimneys on Buried City, the same source as the other ducks. Old Town is a good first stop.
obtain.zh: 掩埋废城鸟城事件的烟囱，来源与其他鸭子相同。可先去老城区。

verdict.en: Sell it: 10,000 coins at only 0.2 weight, and nothing current needs it.
verdict.zh: 卖掉：重量仅 0.2 却值 10000 钱币，目前没有需求。

obtain.en: Scavenge Residential and Commercial loot. The wiki names no spots, so it is luck of the draw while looting apartments and shops.
obtain.zh: 搜刮住宅区和商业区。维基没有具体地点，翻公寓和商店时看运气。

tips.en: It stacks to 3, making it one of the best coins per slot, so grab every copy you see.
tips.zh: 一格可叠3个，单格收益极高，见到就拿。

verdict.en: Nothing current needs it; sell it for 10,000 coins.
verdict.zh: 目前没有需求，直接卖 10000 钱币。

obtain.en: It is a Riven Tides trinket. Guides point to blue luggage bags on beachside areas and say the Dockmaster's Detector helps you find hidden loot.
obtain.zh: 裂潮镇的饰品。攻略指向海滩区域的蓝色行李袋，并称码头主管探测器有助于找到隐藏战利品。

tips.en: One guide lists the value in Merits, not coins. Trust the in-game price here; the item page lists 10,000 coins.
tips.zh: 有攻略把价值写成功勋而非钱币，以游戏内价格为准，本站数据为10000钱币。

verdict.en: Quest-only: take three from the Buried City library for Building a Library.
verdict.zh: 纯任务物品：为“丰富图书室”从掩埋废城图书馆拿3本。

obtain.en: The library is in Buried City's City Center. You need a romance, a detective and an adventure book from its yellow-highlighted shelves across two floors, then extract with all three in one raid. Expect fights and use a Looting Mk. 2 for spare Safe Pockets.
obtain.zh: 图书馆在掩埋废城市中心。需要在两层楼的黄色高亮书架上找到爱情、侦探、冒险各一本，并在同一局内带着三本撤离。这里常有战斗，可用“搜刮 Mk. 2”多腾几个安全口袋。

tips.en: The quest comes from Apollo and rewards an Explosive Mine, a Jolt Mine and a Heavy Fuze Grenade.
tips.zh: 任务来自阿波罗，奖励爆炸地雷、电击地雷和重型引信手雷各一。

verdict.en: A Spaceport quest item for A Lay of the Land, and unsellable.
verdict.zh: 太空港“地形勘查”的任务物品，无法出售。

obtain.en: The scanners are on the upper floor of Control Tower A6 in the Spaceport. Check the foreman's office in the Jiangsu Warehouse, northwest, for the shipping notes first, all in one raid.
obtain.zh: 扫描仪在太空港控制塔A6的上层。先去西北的江苏仓库工头办公室找运货单，需在同一局内完成。

tips.en: Quest rewards are a Dam Testing Annex Key, 3 Ziplines and 2 Smoke Grenades.
tips.zh: 任务奖励大坝测试附楼钥匙、3个滑索和2枚烟雾弹。

verdict.en: Sell them for 2,000 coins each; nothing current needs them.
verdict.zh: 每个卖 2000 钱币，目前没有需求。

use.en: No live project, quest or workshop upgrade asks for it, so it is purely a sale item. At 0.2 weight and stack 3 it is cheap to carry out.
use.zh: 现行项目、任务和工坊升级都不需要它，纯粹是卖钱的物品。重 0.2、可叠 3 个，带出局很轻松。

obtain.en: On Dam Battlegrounds, breach the car hood at the Electrical Substation or the Generator Hall; guides call the substation car nearly guaranteed. Pilgrim's Peak on The Blue Gate also has a breachable container.
obtain.zh: 在大坝战场的变电站或发电机大厅破开汽车引擎盖，攻略称变电站的车几乎必出。蓝门朝圣峰也有可破开的容器。

tips.en: It can't be recycled, and the Power Generation Complex route is often watched by a Rocketeer.
tips.zh: 无法回收；发电综合体那条路线常有火箭手巡逻。

verdict.en: Quest-only: one copy for The Major's Footlocker, and the reward is a Hullcracker Blueprint.
verdict.zh: 任务专用：只需 1 个，交付“少校的储物柜”可得“裂甲者”蓝图。

obtain.en: Dam Battlegrounds, in the apartments northwest of the Dam; Tian Wen's hints point at the Ruby Residence and the Pale Apartments. Search and turn it in within the same raid, and carry it in a Safe Pocket if you can.
obtain.zh: 大坝战场，大坝西北方的公寓楼；天玟的线索指向红宝石宅邸和苍白公寓。同一局内找到并交付，有安全口袋就放进去。

tips.en: Do not sell it: selling gains you 100 coins and the quest stalls.
tips.zh: 别卖，只值 100 钱币，卖了任务就卡住了。

verdict.en: Quest-only: hand one to Celeste for Echoes of Victory Ridge, which also pays out a Music Box.
verdict.zh: 任务专用：交给塞莱斯特完成“凯旋岭的回声”，还送音乐盒。

obtain.en: Dam Battlegrounds, around Victory Ridge. The quest sends you to a hideout under the broken highway for the battle plans, so look around there. Everything is done in one raid.
obtain.zh: 大坝战场，凯旋岭一带。任务要你去断裂高架桥下的藏身处，在那附近找。整个任务需在同一局内完成。

tips.en: The Music Box reward sells for 5,000, so this quest is worth finishing.
tips.zh: 奖励的音乐盒能卖 5000，这个任务值得做完。

verdict.en: A 100-coin quest clue from Line in the Sand; nothing in the workshop needs it, so sell it when the quest is done.
verdict.zh: “沙滩防线”的线索物品，只值 100 钱币，任务后可卖。

obtain.en: Buried City, in a small tower near Piazza Roma, east of the derailed train. Inspect the corner where a bush is growing and a container holds the card.
obtain.zh: 掩埋废城罗马广场附近的小塔楼，位于脱轨列车东侧。检查长着灌木的角落，旁边容器里有名片。

tips.en: Line in the Sand pays 2 Exodus Modules, 2 Magnetic Accelerators and 2 Magnetrons, so it is worth doing.
tips.zh: “沙滩防线”奖励 2 个离巢模块、2 个磁力加速器和 2 个磁电管，值得做。

verdict.en: Quest-only: keep it for Unexpected Initiative, together with the Nutrient Meter.
verdict.zh: 任务专用：留给“计划不如变化快”，要和营养测量仪一起交。

obtain.en: Buried City, on the rooftop of the Grandioso Apartments. Do both meters in one raid, then deliver them to Tian Wen.
obtain.zh: 掩埋废城奢华公寓的屋顶。两个测量仪需在同一局内取得，再交给天玟。

tips.en: The reward is an Il Toro I, 40 Shotgun Ammo and a Shotgun Choke II.
tips.zh: 奖励是“公牛” I、40 发霰弹枪弹药和霰弹枪收束器 II。

verdict.en: Quest-only: the second item for Unexpected Initiative, so keep it.
verdict.zh: 任务专用：“计划不如变化快”的第二件物品，留着。

obtain.en: Buried City, in the broken rooftop gardens of Piazza Roma. Grab it in the same raid as the Moisture Meter and turn both in to Tian Wen.
obtain.zh: 掩埋废城罗马广场破损的屋顶花园。与水分测量仪在同一局拿，一起交给天玟。

verdict.en: Sell it: a Legendary duck worth 10,000 coins for 0.3 weight, and nothing in the game needs it.
verdict.zh: 直接卖：传说级鸭子，0.3 重量值 10000 钱币，游戏里没有任何需求。

use.en: You can throw it as a noise distraction or keep it on a display shelf, but at this price selling is almost always better.
use.zh: 可以扔出去制造噪音，或摆在展示架上，但这个价格还是卖掉更划算。

obtain.en: Only in Buried City while the Bird City condition is active: search the rooftop chimneys. Every nest rolls from a shared pool, so it is pure luck. Rubber ducks are reported mostly on Italian-style terracotta roofs, with Old Town the usual pick.
obtain.zh: 仅在掩埋废城“鸟城”条件开启时出现：搜屋顶烟囱。每个鸟巢都从同一奖池抽取，全看运气。据说多在意式陶土屋顶的建筑上，旧城区较常见。

tips.en: It stacks to 15, but the 0.3 weight means a few copies cost almost no space.
tips.zh: 可堆叠 15 个，重量只有 0.3，带几个几乎不占空间。

verdict.en: Sell it for 3,000 coins unless you are decorating: it takes little space and nothing current needs it.
verdict.zh: 不装饰就卖，3000 钱币，占位小，目前没有需求。

use.en: The Raider Den has a shelf spot that only fits a Music Album. It cannot be recycled.
use.zh: 奇袭者巢穴里有个只能放音乐专辑的展示位。它不能回收。

obtain.en: Scavenged in Residential and Commercial areas with no fixed spawn. Guides name the Arrival Building on The Spaceport, the Abandoned Highway Camp residence in Buried City, and the Ruby Residence on Dam Battlegrounds.
obtain.zh: 在住宅区和商业区搜刮，没有固定刷新点。攻略提到太空港到达大楼、掩埋废城废弃公路营地的住宅，以及大坝战场红宝石宅邸。

tips.en: The Arrival and Departure buildings on The Spaceport often have ARC nearby, so expect a fight.
tips.zh: 太空港的到达和出发大楼常有 ARC 出没，做好战斗准备。

verdict.en: A 5,000-coin trinket: sell it, since nothing needs it.
verdict.zh: 5000 钱币的饰品：没有需求，直接卖。

obtain.en: Scavenged in Old World, Residential and Commercial areas. You also receive one from the Divided and Echoes of Victory Ridge quests.
obtain.zh: 在旧世界、住宅区和商业区搜刮。完成“分歧”和“凯旋岭的回声”任务也会各给 1 个。

tips.en: Those quest rewards are an easy 10,000 coins in total.
tips.zh: 这两个任务奖励的音乐盒合计约 10000 钱币。

verdict.en: A new 2.0 item tied to Celeste, with no sell value: hold it until we know its use.
verdict.zh: 2.0 新增物品，与塞莱斯特有关，无售价：先留着，看用途再定。

obtain.en: No community guide covers it yet and its spawn is unconfirmed. Its description says Celeste would be interested, so check her quests.
obtain.zh: 目前没有社区攻略，刷新位置未确认。描述提到塞莱斯特会感兴趣，可留意她的任务。

verdict.en: Quest-only: it finishes Shani's Last Entry quest, so keep it.
verdict.zh: 任务专用：用来完成萨尼的“最后条目”，留着。

obtain.en: Stella Montis, in the Seed Vault. Use the right workstation for clues, find a hidden key in the adjacent room, then open the seed deposit box.
obtain.zh: 星辰山种子库。先在正确的工作站找线索，在相邻房间找到隐藏钥匙，再打开种子保管箱。

tips.en: The reward is the White Indigo outfit and a Yellow Light Stick Blueprint.
tips.zh: 奖励是“白靛”服装和黄色荧光棒蓝图。

verdict.en: Quest-only: Cold Storage needs one, and it pays out 3 Gas Mines and a Raider Hatch Key.
verdict.zh: 任务专用：“冷冻储藏”需要 1 本，奖励 3 颗跳雷：持续流失耐力和奇袭者暗门钥匙。

obtain.en: Stella Montis. Search any J Kozma Ventures container; one example is a loading bay container near the wind tunnel extract, reached by dropping down from the second floor.
obtain.zh: 星辰山。搜索任意 J·科兹马创投公司容器，例如风洞撤离点附近装卸区的容器，需从二楼跳下去。

verdict.en: A plain 2,000-coin sell item with no other use.
verdict.zh: 纯卖钱物品，2000 钱币，别无他用。

obtain.en: Scavenged in Old World areas. The wiki lists no specific containers.
obtain.zh: 在旧世界区域搜刮，维基未列出具体容器。

verdict.en: A good pocket sell: 5,000 coins at only 0.2 weight.
verdict.zh: 很划算的小物件：重量仅 0.2，却能卖 5000 钱币。

obtain.en: Scavenged in Residential and Commercial areas, with no named container. It also sits in the Raider Den as a display item.
obtain.zh: 在住宅区和商业区搜刮，没有指定容器。也可作为奇袭者巢穴的展示品。

tips.en: Nothing needs it, so sell it unless you want it on display.
tips.zh: 没有任何需求，不想展示就卖掉。

verdict.en: Quest-only: Lance wants one for A New Type of Plant.
verdict.zh: 任务专用：兰斯的“新型植物”需要 1 株。

obtain.en: Dam Battlegrounds, growing on the Baron Husk in the Old Battleground. Collect it in the same raid and take it to Lance.
obtain.zh: 大坝战场旧战场的“男爵”残骸上。同一局内采集，再交给兰斯。

tips.en: Rewards are a Vita Shot and 5 Antiseptic.
tips.zh: 奖励是 1 支生命针剂和 5 个防腐剂。

verdict.en: A 2,000-coin sell item with no other use.
verdict.zh: 纯卖钱物品，2000 钱币，别无他用。

obtain.en: Scavenged in Residential and Commercial areas; no guide names a container. Hotel Panorama Azzurro on Riven Tides and the Village on The Blue Gate both roll both loot types, so they cover the pool in one stop.
obtain.zh: 在住宅和商业区搜到，没有攻略点名容器。裂潮镇的蔚蓝全景酒店和蓝门的村庄同时出这两类物资，一处就能覆盖。

verdict.en: A 1,000-coin sell item added in 2.0, with no known use.
verdict.zh: 2.0 新增的卖钱物品，1000 钱币，暂无其他用途。

obtain.en: New in 2.0, and a search a week after launch still found no guide or wiki entry for its spawn, so there is no spot to recommend yet.
obtain.zh: 2.0新增，上线一周后再查，仍没有攻略或维基写到它的刷新位置，暂时没有可推荐的地点。

verdict.en: A 2,000-coin sell item. The wiki calls it fragile, so don't bring it into a fight.
verdict.zh: 卖钱物品，2000 钱币。维基称它很易碎，别带着打架。

obtain.en: Scavenged in Old World and Residential areas, with no specific container listed.
obtain.zh: 在旧世界和住宅区搜刮，没有指定容器。

verdict.en: Quest-only: it finishes Tian Wen's Safe Harbor, so keep it and carry it in a Safe Pocket.
verdict.zh: 任务专用：用来完成天玟的“安全港湾”，放进安全口袋。

obtain.en: Riven Tides. Photograph the clue near the kitchen in Hotel Panorama Azzurro, then dig it up at the Tennis Court to the south. Guides disagree on the exact spot, with one saying behind a bench and another saying the northwest corner. A Bombardier may be nearby.
obtain.zh: 裂潮镇。先在蔚蓝全景酒店厨房附近拍下线索，再到南边网球场挖掘。攻略对具体位置说法不一，有说长椅后面，有说西北角。附近可能有投弹手。

tips.en: Complete everything in a single raid. The rewards are a Surge Coil, Heavy Gun Parts and a Horizontal Grip.
tips.zh: 需在同一局内完成。奖励是涌能线圈、重型枪械零件和水平握把。

verdict.en: Quest-only: Stable Housing needs one, and it pays out 5 Seeker Grenades, 5 Lure Grenades and a Snap Hook.
verdict.zh: 任务专用：“稳固住宅”需要 1 份，奖励 5 颗追踪手雷、5 颗诱捕手雷和安全钩。

obtain.en: Stella Montis, from the safe in a side room by the Security Bridge's third-floor stairs. Print a key at the Access Card Printer in the fourth-floor control room, or find the numeric code on the third floor. Do it all in one raid.
obtain.zh: 星辰山，位于安保区过道桥三楼楼梯旁侧室的保险箱。在四楼控制室的门禁卡打印机制作钥匙，或在三楼找数字密码。需在同一局内完成。

verdict.en: Quest-only: it finishes Lance's Empathetic Prototypes and has no sell price.
verdict.zh: 任务专用：用来完成兰斯的“共情原型机”，无售价。

obtain.en: The Spaceport, in the North Trench Tower at the northern edge. Grapple up, go down the stairs, drop onto the crane's cargo crate and release it, then take the core. Bring a Safe Pocket augment for the grappling hook and the core.
obtain.zh: 太空港北端的北壕沟塔。用抓钩上塔、下楼梯、跳上吊臂货箱并解除锁定，然后取走核心。带有安全口袋的增强件，用来放抓钩和核心。

tips.en: The reward is a Canto I and 5,000 XP.
tips.zh: 奖励是“颂歌” I 和 5000 经验。

verdict.en: Quest-only: it finishes Apollo's The Clean Dream, and has no sell price.
verdict.zh: 任务专用：用来完成阿波罗的“净梦计划”，无售价。

obtain.en: The Blue Gate, in the Maintenance Bunker near the centre of the map. After monitoring the Purification System, crawl through the vent in the back-left corner, climb the ladder, and photograph the folders on the desk. The quest also needs a Spaceport step, so it takes two raids.
obtain.zh: 蓝门中部的维护区地堡。监控净化系统后，从左后角通风口爬进去，上梯子，拍下桌上的文件夹。任务还有太空港的步骤，需要两局。

tips.en: Rewards are 2 Deadline, 3 Showstopper and 3 Heavy Fuze Grenades.
tips.zh: 奖励是 2 把“死线”、3 把“耀眼明星”和 3 颗重型引信手雷。

verdict.en: Quest-only: raise it for A Symbol of Unification; otherwise it is a 100-coin sell.
verdict.zh: 任务专用：用于“团结的象征”，不做任务只值 100 钱币。

obtain.en: Dam Battlegrounds, at the Formicai Outpost, in a bag on the medical bed. Raise it on the small platform overlooking the Red Lakes, all in one raid.
obtain.zh: 大坝战场蚁丘山哨站，医疗床上的一个包里。在俯瞰红湖的小平台升起，需在同一局内完成。

tips.en: Rewards are the Aviator outfit, 3 Mod Components and 5 Duct Tape.
tips.zh: 奖励是飞行员服装、3 个改装零件和 5 卷胶带。

verdict.en: The best-paying of the plain valuables: nothing current needs it, so sell it.
verdict.zh: 这类普通贵重品里卖价最高的一件：目前没有需求，直接卖。

use.en: No live project, quest or workshop upgrade asks for it, so it is purely a 5,000-coin sale item.
use.zh: 现行项目、任务和工坊升级都不需要它，纯粹是卖 5000 钱币的物品。

obtain.en: Scavenged from loot in Residential, Old World and Commercial areas. The wiki names no fixed container, so check shelves, drawers and cabinets in houses and shops.
obtain.zh: 在住宅、旧世界和商业类区域的搜刮点出现，社区没有固定容器的记录，进屋翻柜子和抽屉即可。

tips.en: It cannot be recycled and weighs only 0.3, so it costs almost no space for the money.
tips.zh: 无法回收，重量仅 0.3，占背包很少，却很值钱。

verdict.en: Sell it unless you still need the one from A Warm Place To Rest; it is a mid-value pickup.
verdict.zh: 中等价值的拾取物，除非还要交温暖的休憩之地，否则直接卖。

obtain.en: Spawns as loot in Old World and Residential areas. You also get one as a reward for the Buried City quest A Warm Place To Rest (Apollo).
obtain.zh: 出现在旧世界和住宅类区域的搜刮点。掩埋废城任务“温暖的休憩之地”（阿波罗）也会送你 1 个。

tips.en: Nothing in the workshop or projects needs it. A displayed copy in the Raider Den is the only reason to keep one.
tips.zh: 工坊和项目都不需要它，留一个只可能是为了摆在奇袭者巢穴里。

verdict.en: A cheap, harmless noisemaker: keep one for the Raider Den or distraction, sell the extras.
verdict.zh: 便宜好玩的噪音道具：留一只摆放或引开敌人，多的卖掉。

use.en: Throw it to make noise and pull attention away. Since 2.0 you can also squeeze it while holding it, so you do not lose the duck.
use.zh: 可以扔出去制造声响分散注意力；2.0 起手持时直接捏一下就会响，不用丢掉它。

obtain.en: Found in rooftop chimneys on Buried City while the Bird City condition is active. Without that condition it is far rarer.
obtain.zh: 掩埋废城出现“鸟城”条件时，在屋顶烟囱里能找到；没有该条件时很难遇到。

tips.en: It stacks to 15 and fits an Augment trinket slot, so one duck costs you nothing to carry.
tips.zh: 可叠加 15 个，也能放进增强装置的饰品槽，带一只几乎没成本。

verdict.en: Quest item for Dust on the Wires; not worth carrying for any other reason.
verdict.zh: 仅用于“线路积尘”的任务物品，别的用途没有。

obtain.en: Take the quest from Shani, then search the scouts' remains near the Maintenance Hangar on The Spaceport. Start at an eastern Field Depot to follow their trail.
obtain.zh: 向萨尼接任务，到太空港维护区机库附近搜查侦察兵的遗骸即可拿到。可从东侧的前线仓库开始顺着踪迹找。

tips.en: Do the radio and terminal steps first; the note only matters once you hand it in.
tips.zh: 先完成电台和终端的步骤，笔记交付才有意义。

verdict.en: Quest item for Furtive Meetings; pick it up on Stella Montis and hand it to Shani.
verdict.zh: “秘密集会”的任务物品，在星辰山拿到后交给萨尼。

obtain.en: Stella Montis. The quest marks three meeting spots: under a staircase in the Medical Research Area, by the vent shaft between Robotic Sandbox B and the Seed Vault, and at the foot of the stairs linking the Cultural Archives and the Seed Vault. The wiki does not say which one holds it, so check them all in one raid.
obtain.zh: 星辰山。任务标出三处集会点：医学研究部楼梯下、机器人沙盘B 与种子库之间的通风井旁，以及文化档案馆与种子库之间的楼梯底部。社区未说明具体在哪一处，一局内全部查一遍最稳。

tips.en: The reward is an Aphelion and 5 Energy Clips, so it is worth finishing once.
tips.zh: 奖励是一把“远日点”和 5 个能量弹匣，值得做完。

verdict.en: Plain 2,000-coin sale item now; Clean Hands is the only free copy you will get.
verdict.zh: 现在只是个卖 2000 钱币的物品，“清理指针”送的那个是唯一的免费来源。

use.en: No live project, quest or workshop upgrade asks for it, so it is purely a sale item.
use.zh: 现行项目、任务和工坊升级都不需要它，纯粹是卖钱的物品。

obtain.en: Plain scavenged loot; the wiki gives no fixed spawn spots. Clean Hands gives you one.
obtain.zh: 属于普通搜刮物，社区没有固定刷新点。“清理指针”任务会送你 1 个。

tips.en: Stack size is 5 and it cannot be recycled, so sell in batches.
tips.zh: 一组可叠 5 个，无法回收，攒几个一起卖。

verdict.en: Rare household valuable worth 3000: light, unrecyclable, just sell it.
verdict.zh: 3000 的稀有家居贵重品，轻便又不能回收，直接卖。

obtain.en: Found in houses and shops across Residential, Old World and Commercial areas; look in cupboards and drawers.
obtain.zh: 分布在住宅、旧世界和商业类区域，翻橱柜和抽屉就有机会遇到。

tips.en: Nothing needs it, so it only ever earns coins.
tips.zh: 没有任何任务或项目需要，只能换钱。

verdict.en: Epic ship model worth 7,000 coins: nothing current needs it, so sell it.
verdict.zh: 7000 钱币的史诗级舰船模型：目前没有需求，卖掉。

use.en: No live project, quest or workshop upgrade asks for it, so the sale price is its whole value.
use.zh: 现行项目、任务和工坊升级都不需要它，售价就是它的全部价值。

obtain.en: Mostly Riven Tides: shipping containers, suitcases, trash bins and control panels in the stacking yard. These are community-recorded spawns; I could not confirm them for other maps.
obtain.zh: 主要在裂潮镇：集装箱、行李箱、垃圾桶，以及堆料场的控制面板。以上为社区记录的刷新点，其他地图未能确认。

tips.en: It stacks to 3 and cannot be recycled, so the sale price is its whole value.
tips.zh: 可叠加 3 个且不能回收，售价就是它的全部价值。

verdict.en: Quest item for Movie Night: grab it in the Cultural Archives and hand it to Apollo.
verdict.zh: “电影之夜”的任务物品，在文化档案馆拿到后交给阿波罗。

obtain.en: Stella Montis, Cultural Archives. The area is well guarded. Apollo wants intact tapes, not torn ones. First deliver a Portable TV to him.
obtain.zh: 星辰山文化档案馆，守卫较多。阿波罗要的是完好的录像带，破损的不行。需先给他交一台便携电视。

tips.en: Rewards are 3 Showstoppers, 3 Smoke Grenades and a Fireworks Box. Requires finishing With A View first.
tips.zh: 奖励为 3 个“耀眼明星”、3 枚烟雾手雷和 1 个烟花箱，需先完成“美景在望”。

verdict.en: Sell it: 3000 coins for 0.3 weight and nothing else needs it.
verdict.zh: 直接卖：重量 0.3 就值 3000，没有任何其他用途。

obtain.en: Appears in Old World and Residential areas as ordinary loot. No fixed container is known.
obtain.zh: 出现在旧世界和住宅类区域，属于普通搜刮物，没有固定容器的记录。

tips.en: Stacks to 3 and cannot be recycled.
tips.zh: 可叠加 3 个，不能回收。

verdict.en: Epic trinket worth 7,000 coins: nothing current needs it, so sell it.
verdict.zh: 7000 钱币的史诗级饰品，目前没有需求，卖掉。

use.en: No live project, quest or workshop upgrade asks for it, so it is purely a sale item.
use.zh: 现行项目、任务和工坊升级都不需要它，纯粹是卖钱的物品。

obtain.en: No fixed spawn is documented; it is scavenged loot, and A Path Not Yours gives one as a reward.
obtain.zh: 没有固定刷新点记录，属于搜刮物，“非你之路”任务也会奖励 1 个。

tips.en: It stacks only to 1, so each one takes a full slot; sell right after the raid.
tips.zh: 一格只能放 1 个，局后尽快卖掉。

verdict.en: A 1000-coin common book: sell it if there is spare space, skip it otherwise.
verdict.zh: 1000 的普通旧书，有空位就捡来卖，没空位别管。

obtain.en: Residential and Old World loot spots, mostly shelves and furniture.
obtain.zh: 在住宅和旧世界区域的搜刮点，多在书架和家具上。

tips.en: It is low value per slot compared to the rare trinkets, so do not make room for it.
tips.zh: 相比稀有饰品性价比低，不用特意腾位置。

verdict.en: Sell it: 1,000 coins, stacks to 10, and nothing current needs it.
verdict.zh: 卖掉：1000 钱币，可叠 10 个，目前没有需求。

obtain.en: Interior loot from furnished homes. The only confirmed sighting in guides is Ruby Residence on Dam Battlegrounds; other spots are unconfirmed leads.
obtain.zh: 来自有家具的室内。攻略里唯一确认的发现点是大坝战场的红宝石宅邸，其余地点都只是未证实的线索。

tips.en: A stack of 10 sells in one go, so wait until you have a few.
tips.zh: 一组可叠 10 个，攒几个再一起卖。

verdict.en: A Bird City chimney find: keep one for the Raider Den, sell the rest.
verdict.zh: 鸟城条件下烟囱里的收获：留一只装饰，其余卖掉。

obtain.en: Buried City only, in rooftop chimneys while Bird City is active.
obtain.zh: 仅限掩埋废城，出现“鸟城”条件时在屋顶烟囱中。

tips.en: It can be thrown to make noise, like other ducks.
tips.zh: 和其他鸭子一样，可扔出制造声响。

verdict.en: A 1,000-coin sale item with no remaining use. Dump it after the raid.
verdict.zh: 1000 钱币的卖钱物品，已无其他用途，局后卖掉。

obtain.en: Riven Tides, with chairs in the Panorama Azzurro Hotel the most mentioned spot; other spawns across the map.
obtain.zh: 裂潮镇，被提到最多的是蔚蓝全景酒店的椅子，地图其他地方也有。

tips.en: Stacks to 5 and cannot be recycled.
tips.zh: 可叠 5 个，不能回收。

verdict.en: New in 2.0 with no sell price: community pages say nothing yet, so check it in game.
verdict.zh: 2.0 新增，无售价，社区暂无资料，请以游戏内为准。

tips.en: I found no wiki page for this item; do not assume it works like ARC Circuitry.
tips.zh: 我没找到该物品的社区页面，别默认它和 ARC线圈相同。

obtain.en: No guide or wiki page mentions where it comes from a week after launch, so its source is still unknown.
obtain.zh: 上线一周后仍没有攻略或维基页面提到它的来源，目前不明。

verdict.en: Sell it for 3000, but handle it carefully because it is fragile.
verdict.zh: 卖 3000，但它很易碎，要小心。

obtain.en: Old World, Residential and Commercial loot spots.
obtain.zh: 旧世界、住宅和商业类区域的搜刮点。

tips.en: The wiki warns the vase is super fragile; don't take hits while carrying it.
tips.zh: 社区提示花瓶极易碎，携带时尽量别挨打。

verdict.en: Cash it in at 3,000 coins; no quest or project wants it now.
verdict.zh: 直接兑现 3000 钱币，现在没有任务或项目要它。

obtain.en: Chairs and furniture on Riven Tides, plus suitcases and trash; also Grandioso Apartments (Buried City), Ruby Residents and Pale Apartments (Dam Battlegrounds).
obtain.zh: 裂潮镇的椅子和家具、行李箱与垃圾堆；掩埋废城的奢华公寓、大坝战场的红宝石宅邸和苍白公寓也有记录。

tips.en: 3000 coins and stacks to 3.

verdict.en: Keep 3 for the Scrappy level 5 upgrade, then sell the rest.
verdict.zh: 为废品仔 5 级升级留 3 个，其余卖掉。

obtain.en: Residential and Commercial interiors. Guides rate the Testing Annex on Dam Battlegrounds fastest (green and white drawers, red lockers, office cabinets); Grandioso Apartments, Plaza Rosa and the Red Tower on Buried City and the Village on The Blue Gate are the other picks.
obtain.zh: 住宅和商业类室内。攻略认为大坝战场的测试附楼最快（绿色、白色抽屉，红色储物柜和办公柜）；其次是掩埋废城的奢华公寓、玫瑰广场、红塔和蓝门的村庄。

tips.en: Scrappy level 5 also needs 12 Mushrooms and 12 Apricots.
tips.zh: 废品仔 5 级还需要 12 个蘑菇和 12 个杏子。

verdict.en: Worth 2,000 coins and nothing more; sell it when you extract.
verdict.zh: 只值 2000 钱币，别无他用，撤离后卖掉。

obtain.en: Commercial and Residential loot. One guide's testing found it most in Santa Maria Houses and Abandoned Highway Camp on Buried City, with Grandioso Apartments, Space Travel, Ruby Residence, Pale Apartments and the Arrival and Departure Buildings also listed.
obtain.zh: 商业和住宅类物资。有攻略实测在掩埋废城的圣玛丽亚住宅区和废弃的高速公路营地最常见，奢华公寓、航天大楼、红宝石宅邸、苍白公寓以及到达楼、候机楼也榜上有名。

tips.en: Stacks to 5, cannot be recycled.
tips.zh: 可叠 5 个，不能回收。

verdict.en: The cheapest ship model: sell it for 1,000 coins or display it.
verdict.zh: 最便宜的舰船模型：卖 1000 钱币或摆放。

obtain.en: A chair in the Panorama Azzurro Hotel on Riven Tides is the documented spot.
obtain.zh: 有记录的位置是裂潮镇蔚蓝全景酒店的一把椅子。

tips.en: Stacks to 10 and cannot be recycled.
tips.zh: 可叠 10 个，不能回收。
